Flow.description: Universal entry point for the FQS Guided Gift Entry suite. Callable from the Account record page (via the Account.FQS_Guided_Gift_Entry quick action, which auto-injects recordId) and from the Home page (via a flexipage:flowComponent on FQS_Home_Page_Default, which leaves recordId null). The flow's only job is to fill in the missing Account context when the user launched from Home: if recordId is blank, show a screen with a native Account lookup and stamp the chosen Account Id into a local variable; otherwise reuse the caller-supplied recordId as-is. In both cases the flow then hands off to the shared monolith FQS_Gift_Entry_Single_Launcher_Account as a subflow, passing the resolved Account Id as recordId — the monolith's Get_Acct chain runs against that donor and every downstream leaf (Outright, Pledge, Recurring, Grant, In-Kind, Earned Income, Event Registration) works unchanged. No local screens after the subflow; the monolith's Screen_Success is terminal and the guide ends there.
Flow.label: FQS Gift Entry Guide — Universal

decisions.name: Decide_Has_RecordId
decisions.label: Have an Account Id already?
decisions.description: Entry-mode router. Account-quick-action entry supplies recordId (the Account Id). Home-page entry via the flexipage:flowComponent does not — user must pick a donor on the first screen. This decision routes on recordId presence: has a value routes past the picker; blank routes to Screen_Pick_Donor.
decisions.defaultConnectorLabel: Home entry — need to pick donor

screens.name: Screen_Pick_Donor
screens.label: Pick a Donor
screens.description: Home-page entry only. Uses the native flowruntime:lookup on Account (fieldApiName=AccountId) so the org's Account lookup filters apply — that lets an admin scope the picker to donor record types via a filter on the lookup field rather than hard-coding a filter here. The chosen Account Id lands in lkpDonor.recordId and is stamped into var_Acct_DonorId by the next Assignment before the monolith subflow call. allowBack is true on this first screen per the flow-screen-authoring-gotchas memory.

fields.name: PickDonor_Header
fields.fieldText:
Who is this gift for?

Pick the Account of the donor, household, or organization giving the gift. You can search by name.

assignments.name: Assign_Donor_From_RecordId
assignments.label: Use Account-Page Record Id
assignments.description: Account-quick-action entry. recordId already holds the Account Id (Salesforce injects it via the quick action); copy it into var_Acct_DonorId so the downstream subflow call reads from a single source variable in both entry modes.

assignments.name: Assign_Donor_From_Picker
assignments.label: Use Picked Account
assignments.description: Home-page entry. lkpDonor is a flowruntime:lookup screen field on Account with fieldApiName=AccountId; its .recordId output holds the chosen Account Id (see flowruntime-lookup-pattern memory). Copy it into var_Acct_DonorId so the downstream subflow call reads from a single source variable in both entry modes.

subflows.name: Sub_Monolith
subflows.label: Guided Gift Entry (Shared)
subflows.description: Delegates to the shared FQS gift-entry monolith with recordId set to the resolved donor Account Id (either the caller-supplied recordId or the Home-page picked donor). No contextCommitmentId — that input is only set when the flow is invoked from the GiftCommitment surface (via FQS_Gift_Entry_Guide_GiftCommitment). With contextCommitmentId null, the monolith's Decide_Entry_Mode default branch falls through to Get_Acct and the standard category-picker chain runs. The monolith's Screen_Success is terminal so this parent has no downstream elements.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Optional input: Id of the Account from which the flow is launched. Populated automatically by the Account quick action; left blank by the Home-page flexipage:flowComponent. Decide_Has_RecordId branches on this variable's presence.

variables.name: var_Acct_DonorId
variables.description: Resolved Account Id passed to the Sub_Monolith subflow's recordId input. Written by Assign_Donor_From_RecordId on the Account-entry path and by Assign_Donor_From_Picker on the Home-entry path. Read only by the subflow call. Existed to give the subflow call a single-source input regardless of entry surface.
